name: render_map
description: Render an interactive map card (NASA terra-map) for the user. Use when the user wants to SEE data on a map: Harmony GeoTIFF outputs (pass the .tif links from get_transformation_job_status), a collection's GIBS imagery (pass collection_concept_id and a date), explicit GIBS layer ids, a request bbox, or granule footprints from get_granules. The map is shown to the user; you receive a short text summary only. Only call this when a visual is wanted or clearly useful, not for every search result.
